title: Hans Brinker; Or, The Silver Skates
summary: "Hans Brinker; Or, The Silver Skates" by Mary Mapes Dodge is a children's novel published in 1865. Set in early 19th-century Holland, it follows poor siblings Hans and Gretel Brinker as they dream of competing in a great ice-skating race for silver skates. Their father suffers from a mysterious head injury that has left the family destitute.
